failure_history.detail: Blanket45m answer key contradicted official conditional B11.3 rules; original retained, not scored as a model failure.
General other-works permissions did not identify separate road excavation permission. Retained; traffic checklist corrected; final-16 rerun.
Insurer notification without request for insurance coverage records. Retained; labour response guidance corrected; two fresh final9 runs.

Generic evaluator instruction requested web verification despite prompt requesting no further checking. Earlier lookup observations are not evidence of respecting that constraint; final-28 uses no retrieval.

limits: Grouped cases share evaluator context; separate workers/repeats provide fresh contexts, not statistical independence for all cases.
Raw artifacts are retained locally in ignored workspace. Hashes identify reviewed versions.
Cases7,8,10,12 retain reviewed baseline results; no relevant behavioural change required rerunning them.
Current-source access sometimes used official search extracts; individual artifacts disclose failures and versions.
Case24 is explicitly synthetic/offline and does not test retrieval of a real archived instrument.
